description:
Pressing shift+L in the tree overlay should open an inline label-editing input. This feature is not implemented in Elixir.

## Upstream behavior (tree-selector.ts TreeSelectorComponent)

### Activation
- Keybinding: app.tree.editLabel (default: shift+l)
- When triggered, calls this.treeList.onLabelEdit(entryId, currentLabel)
- TreeSelectorComponent.showLabelInput(entryId, currentLabel) replaces treeContainer content with LabelInput

### LabelInput render output
The label input replaces the tree entries area (treeContainer is cleared):
```
  Label (empty to remove):         ← 2-space indent, muted color
  > [text input with cursor]       ← inline pi-tui Input component, indented 2 spaces
  enter save  escape/ctrl+c cancel ← key hints via keyHint()
```

### LabelInput behavior
- Pre-filled with currentLabel if one exists
- enter / tui.select.confirm: save (trim whitespace; empty string → clears label, undefined)
- escape / tui.select.cancel: cancel without saving
- After submit: calls treeList.updateNodeLabel(entryId, label, labelTimestamp)
  - Updates node.label and node.labelTimestamp in the in-memory flatNodes
  - Calls onLabelChangeCallback if registered
- After submit or cancel: LabelInput removed, treeContainer restored

### updateNodeLabel
Upstream: scans flatNodes for the entry ID, sets node.label and node.labelTimestamp (ISO timestamp).
Label clearing: label = undefined when empty string submitted.

## Elixir gaps

- No app.tree.editLabel handler in handle_key/2
- No label_input: nil field in TreeSelector struct
- No inline input component for label editing in render/2
- No update_node_label/3 equivalent: labeled nodes in Elixir use flat_nodes / filtered_nodes from
  OctoPi.Coder.Components.TreeSelector — updating in-memory requires patching TreeNode.label in
  the flat_nodes list

## Design note

Elixir does not have a pi-tui Input component equivalent embedded in the TUI layer the same way.
The existing OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input or similar should be used. When LabelInput is active,
handle_key/2 should route keys to the label input rather than the tree navigation.

Emit a {:label_change, entry_id, label} event so the parent (interactive.ex) can persist the
label to the session store if/when that is implemented.

## Where to fix

apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/tree_selector.ex:
- Add label_input field to struct
- Add app.tree.editLabel handler in handle_key/2
- When label_input active, route keys there instead of tree navigation
- Add render/2 branch for label_input mode (replace tree list lines with label input lines)
- Add update_flat_node_label/3 private function

## Upstream references
- LabelInput class lines 1065-1135 in tree-selector.ts
- showLabelInput/hideLabelInput in TreeSelectorComponent lines 1200-1230 in tree-selector.ts
- handleInput routing (labelInput present) lines 1240-1246 in tree-selector.ts
- keyHint() usage in LabelInput.render for the save/cancel hints

## Verification
Open /tree, navigate to an entry, press shift+L. Confirm the label input replaces the tree.
Type a label and press Enter. Confirm [label] appears on the entry. Press shift+L again, clear
the input and submit — confirm the label is removed.
title: /tree label editing: shift+L opens inline LabelInput modal
